sloka: सर्वान् समभिधावन्तं यथा रुष्टं दिशागजम्।मार्गमाणं हरीन् क्रुद्धं राक्षसैः परिवारितम् ।। ६.६७.१२६ ।।
transliteration: sarvān samabhidhāvantaṁ yathā ruṣṭaṁ diśāgajam।mārgamāṇaṁ harīn kruddhaṁ rākṣasaiḥ parivāritam ।। 6.67.126 ।।

translations.english: Rama once again taking the bow, split the peak of the mountain with seven unfailing arrows on its way even before it reached the target.
